text:
liam: AM async — quick capacity check for AMS + APAC. Headroom in ams1 dipped to ~18% around 03:12 UTC. Prewarm cron ran at 03:00 and added 6 p4d nodes but we still saw a few evictions. Anyone on the quota uplift path?

emma: saw the eviction spikes in metrics (03:14-03:22). Looks like a long-running training job in eu-west1 leaked into AMS because of a routing-tag bug. I killed train-legacy-42, cache prefix hits stayed good so p99 latency only blipped.

sajid: what I did: bumped autoscaler max by +10% for AMS overnight, reduced default batch_size on model-router for small requests. Blocker: APAC GCP GPU quota request still pending (ticket GCP-9876). Today: following up with cloud-ops + vendor contact, will open emergency uplift if no response.

liam: can you paste the ticket link and ETA? Also would like a small canary of the model-router change in APAC tonight during the low-traffic window.

sajid: ticket (internal): https://support.google.com/cloud/cases/GCP-9876. I also filed a temporary increase via vendor portal. Canary planned at 23:30 APAC local (low traffic).

emma: quick inline check to eyeball headroom if needed: 
```
gcloud compute regions describe europe-west1 --project=redwood-prod --format="value(quotas)"
```

ops-bot: deploybot: model-router v2.1.4 rolled to canary eu-west1 at 2025-11-12T03:45:12Z (status: success).

liam: blocker for me: need confirmation that dedicated pools are insulated from the spillover rules. @sajid can you confirm? If not confirmed we'll flip strict routing to dedicated for the next 2 hours.

sajid: confirmed — I set routing.policy.spillover=false for dedicated pools in AMS and pushed the change. Rolling update in progress.

emma: thanks. I'll watch the latency dashboards (per-route p95/p99) and add an alert if headroom drops <15% — then we trigger scale-prewarm +20%.

liam: @oncall-sre please keep an eye on AMS and APAC queues for the next 3 hours. If you see sustained evictions escalate to paging. Last update from me at 04:10 UTC. :white_check_mark:
